name: Wine Jar (Hu)
summary: Bronze。32.4 × 19.7 cm (12 3/4 × 7 3/4 in.); Diam.: 19.7 cm (7 3/4 in.)。Gift of Naomi Donnelley
history: This vessel displays a rich variety of ornament and filler patterns: Two thick bands of interlaced dragons, their bodies filled with spirals, triangles, and dots, alternate with thinner bands.
